name: kiwi-agent
description: Coding sessions in VS Code with a choice of model engine per session.

commands.title: KiwiAgent: Set API Key for Profile
KiwiAgent: Migrate plans to the spec contract

kiwiAgent.activeProfile.description: Name of the profile in kiwiAgent.profiles used for new sessions.

kiwiAgent.planProfile.description: Profile used for plan sessions. Empty: same as activeProfile.

kiwiAgent.planIgnore.description: Workspace-relative globs a Plan session must not read, carved out of docs/** and the root README. Example: docs/api/**.

kiwiAgent.permissions.allow.description: Tool calls that run without a prompt, on every engine. A rule is a tool name (Edit), a tool with a glob on the workspace-relative path (Edit(src/**)), or Bash or PowerShell with a command: Bash(npm test) for that exact command, PowerShell(npm run:*) for any command starting with those words; a rule for one shell says nothing about the other. Every segment of a chained command must be covered or read-only. "Allow for project" on a prompt writes here; "Allow for session" keeps the rule in memory for that session instead. Read-only tools and commands (Read, Grep, ls, git status, ...) never prompt.

kiwiAgent.permissions.deny.description: Tool calls blocked outright, same rule shape as permissions.allow. Wins over allow rules and over read-only calls: Read(**/.env), Bash(curl:*).

kiwiAgent.traceEngine.description: Log every message from the Claude engine (one line each) to the KiwiAgent output channel. Applies to sessions started after the change.

kiwiAgent.nodePath.description: Node executable used to run the Claude engine. Empty: VS Code's own executable in Node mode.

kiwiAgent.verify.description: Test commands run once every task of a feature is marked tested, over the files its tasks name: a matching file runs its rule's command once per project. {project} is the nearest file matching 'project' above the file, {projectDir} its directory. A failure is handed to the implement session, up to the failure budget.

match.description: Glob on the workspace-relative path of a file a task touches.

project.description: Glob for the project file to look for upwards from the file, e.g. *.csproj.

kiwiAgent.verifyFailureBudget.description: Consecutive failed test runs handed to the implement session before the failed record is left for you.

kiwiAgent.cleanup.functionLines.description: Code lines a function may have before the cleanup run after a feature's tests pass splits it; 0 turns the limit off.

kiwiAgent.cleanup.typeLines.description: Code lines a class, struct or other type may have before the cleanup run splits it; 0 turns the limit off.

kiwiAgent.cleanup.fileLines.description: Code lines a file may have before the cleanup run splits it; 0 turns the limit off.

kiwiAgent.cleanup.ignore.description: Workspace-relative globs of edited files the cleanup never measures: tests, generated code.

apiKeySecret.description: Name under which the API key is stored in VS Code secret storage.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies
